name: @repo/api
description: Python workspace wrapper: lets Turborepo run uv commands like any other app.

scripts.dev: uv run python -m app.db.migrate --keep-going && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.db:setup: pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
